caption_L2L3: Over the 9 years from 2010 to 2019 there has been a small increase but steady year on year increase in the internal consumption of travel and tourism in Honduras.  In 2010 consumption stood at USD2bn.  By 2019 consumption had risen to USD2.3bn.  The growth rate was broadly steady but with a slight increase in 2014 followed by a slight decline in 2015 before the growth rate returned to it's previous steady state.
